title: api03_instance_read_test.zig — DebugAllocator leak: discarded AppendResult.record.metadata
scope: tests/integration/api03_instance_read_test.zig (test-only leak, no production code path affected). Forwarded from ISS-0691/GH-753 scope expansion at Step 00.
description: tests/integration/api03_instance_read_test.zig leaks one heap allocation per run. The discarded AppendResult captures the return value of store.append() with _ =, but the returned .record.metadata is heap-allocated by duplicateFromParams() (src/event_store/store.zig:1368). Same-shape leak as ISS-0691/GH-753 (different file, same root cause). Filed as a separate issue per core-directive one issue, one run.
disposition: Test-only allocation leak; no production code path affected. Fix: capture the AppendResult and free result.record.metadata.
resolution: WF03-GH755-20260813 — captured AppendResult in api03_instance_read_test.zig line 988 (TC-API-05-01), freed record.metadata with defer if (append_res.record.metadata.len > 0) alloc.free(...). Mirrors GH-753/ISS-0691 fix pattern. Verified syntactically (zig ast-check exit 0) and full zig build exit 0. Runtime integration test verification deferred to follow-up — GH-758 client hang currently blocks reliable test-integration execution. Pattern identical to merged GH-753 (commit 34d0512c) which was verified in production.
